name: App window lifecycle
user_story: As a user, I can launch, reopen, and activate Crate without a zero-window state.

name: Projects and Current Project
user_story: As a designer, I can create, select, watch, pause, and return to a project workspace.
coverage_note: Automation covers opening the project form. Selection, watch, pause, and return remain installed-app QA lanes.

name: Dependency capture
user_story: As a designer, Crate gathers project dependencies from supported creative applications while I work.
coverage_note: Automation covers provenance primitives only. Multi-application live capture remains parser tests plus manual creative-app QA.

name: Quick Package
user_story: As a user, I can package one approved source file without starting a watched project.

automated_evidence.contains: Quick Package extracts PowerPoint embedded media without reporting them missing

coverage_note: Automation covers parser output. The Quick Package UI, destination choice, and quota behavior have separate evidence lanes.

name: Package review, complete, and details
user_story: As a user, I can review package contents and understand what Crate included or excluded.

automated_evidence.contains: Package Details shows the no-issue state

coverage_note: Automation covers Package Details rendering. Package Review and Package Complete remain installed-app QA lanes.

name: Needs save
user_story: As a user, I am warned when an unsaved source document prevents safe linked-asset packaging.
manual_only_reason: The Illustrator unsaved-linked-asset lane is validated through Illustrator Smoke 2.

name: Figma project link and scope
user_story: As a Figma user, I can link a project with Current Page Only by default and opt into Entire File.

automated_evidence.contains: explicit Entire File still packages Figma assets from any page
defaults missing or invalid scope to Current Page Only

name: Figma privacy and errors
user_story: As a user, Figma errors remain actionable without exposing tokens, file keys, URLs, or signed assets.

automated_evidence.contains: fails closed with a safe diagnostic

name: Diagnostics and provenance
user_story: As a user, diagnostics are off by default and remain isolated from normal design assets when enabled.

automated_evidence.contains: default package omits diagnostic report files
package provenance records copied files and skips missing files

coverage_note: Automation covers default-off and enabled manifest placement; installed-app QA confirms the Settings toggle and Package Details copy.

name: Package exclusions
user_story: As a user, Crate excludes package outputs, old QA roots, diagnostics, and unrelated local files.

automated_evidence.contains: automatic live capture ignores old package output and diagnostics folders

name: Quota and plan states
user_story: As a user, successful packages increment quota and exhausted quota writes no output.

automated_evidence.contains: Quick Package consumes package quota only after successful packaging

name: Idle project alerts
user_story: As a user, I can keep watching, pause, or package a project from the inactivity alert.
manual_only_reason: Keep Watching, Pause, and Package Now are validated in the installed-app idle-alert smoke lane.
